scripts.title: Noclip Script For Any Game
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local noclip = false

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end

	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.N then
		noclip = not noclip
		print("Noclip:", noclip and "ON" or "OFF")
	end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	if not player.Character then return end

	for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			part.CanCollide = not noclip
		end
	end
end)

• Extended Guide — exact shot preview running the game's own physics engine

🧰 UTILITY

    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.ZIndex = 3
    hit.Parent = track_

    local current = default

    local function set(v, updateBox)
        v = tonumber(v)
        if not v then v = current end
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        current = v
        local t = (max == min) and 0 or (v - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
        if updateBox ~= false then box.Text = string.format("%.2f", v) end
        local ok, err = pcall(callback, v)
        if not ok then warn("[Boombox] slider callback:", err) end
    end

    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local function update(i)
                local rel = (i.Position.X - track_.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track_.AbsoluteSize.X)
                rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
                set(min + rel * (max - min), true)
            end
            activeDrag = update
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if enter then set(box.Text, true) end
    end)

    set(default, true)
    return { set = set, get = function() return current end, frame = row }
end

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then
        state.sound:Resume()
        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")
    end
end

    end)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in ipairs(tabs) do
            local sel = (t == entry)

    return entry
end

scripts.script:
--[[
    Anti-Kick Universal Script
    Funciona em: Synapse, Krnl, Fluxus, Delta, Hydrogen, etc.
    Ativa automaticamente ao executar
]]

-- Configurações
local config = {
    antiKick = true,        -- Bloqueia kicks
    antiDisconnect = true,  -- Bloqueia desconexões forçadas
    antiTeleport = true,    -- Bloqueia teleportes forçados
    notify = true,          -- Notifica quando algo for bloqueado
}

-- Serviços
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Detectar executor
local executor = "Desconhecido"
if syn then executor = "Synapse"
elseif KRNL_LOADED then executor = "Krnl"
elseif Fluxus then executor = "Fluxus"
elseif identifyexecutor then executor = pcall(function() executor = identifyexecutor() end)
end

-- Função de notificação
local function notify(title, text)
    if not config.notify then return end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = title,
            Text = text,
            Duration = 3,
        })
    end)
end

-- Bloquear Kick
local oldKick
oldKick = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Kick, function(self, message)
    if config.antiKick then
        notify("Anti-Kick", "Kick bloqueado: " .. tostring(message))
        return
    end
    return oldKick(self, message)
end)

-- Bloquear Disconnect (método alternativo)
local oldDisconnect
if LocalPlayer.Disconnect then
    oldDisconnect = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Disconnect, function(self)
        if config.antiDisconnect then
            notify("Anti-Kick", "Disconnect bloqueado")
            return
        end
        return oldDisconnect(self)
    end)
end

-- Proteção contra Teleport forçado
local oldTeleport
if LocalPlayer.Teleport then
    oldTeleport = hookfunction(LocalPlayer.Teleport, function(self, ...)
        if config.antiTeleport then
            notify("Anti-Teleport", "Teleporte bloqueado")
            return
        end
        return oldTeleport(self, ...)
    end)
end

-- Detectar e bloquear via RemoteEvents (tentativa de kick por servidor)
local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local oldNamecall = mt.__namecall

setreadonly(mt, false)
mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    local method = getnamecallmethod()
    local args = {...}
    
    if config.antiKick then
        -- Bloqueia kicks vindos do servidor via remotes comuns
        if method == "Fire" or method == "InvokeServer" then
            if self.Name == "Kick" or self.Name == "Disconnect" then
                notify("Anti-Kick", "Tentativa de kick via remote bloqueada")
                return
            end
        end
    end
    
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end)
setreadonly(mt, true)

-- Notificação inicial
notify("Anti-Kick", "Ativado com sucesso! (" .. executor .. ")")

-- Loop de proteção contínua (re-aplica hooks se necessário)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(5) do
        pcall(function()
            if config.antiKick and not hookmetamethod then
                -- Re-hook básico caso algo tenha resetado
            end
        end)
    end
end)

print("[Anti-Kick] Script carregado | Executor: " .. executor)

scripts.features: This Fishy Hub script forFishing Master uses FishyUI and opens with RightControl, driving the game's own Stardust packets and controllers rather than faking a player. Fishing is packet-exact, handling perfect casts, perfect first pulls, auto reels, counter responses, auto loot confirmation, and auto bait with the best owned option. Auto skills presses the game's real slot binds, and below the fish's finisher HP threshold a skill becomes the only way to land the catch, so that gate overrides the window preference. Gear management covers auto buy and equip rods, plus auto equip of souls, auras, titles, and units, with souls ranked by which skill groups you actually have equipped. Cash tools include locking good fish by rarity, auto selling when the satchel fills, driving the game's own auto-sell filter, and rolling gacha with Coin or Gem only since Robux is never touched. Claim routines handle daily, group, and quest rewards plus code redemption, while World features cover auto hopping to better servers, fast travel with proximity checks, anti-AFK nudges, and an FPS boost. Most features outside fishing were recovered from a saveinstance dump, which gives up method names but not parameter lists, so each resolves its own call shape at runtime and the Info tab prints what actually wired up. Packet sends and listeners are verified at boot, so a renamed packet surfaces as a named missing entry rather than silence.
